updates.description: Partial fields to apply. Setting folder clears parentHostId and vice versa, since a host is either in a folder or nested under a parent host.

pluginEnable.description: Plugin id to on or off, for each plugin that declares a host enable switch.

resetDefaults.description: Hands keys back to the host defaults. `all`, or `namespaces` ("core" or a plugin id), or `keys` as "namespace.key".
